name: Hunk Empire
source:
Kicked out and pulled into his dad’s outrageous adult film empire, a young gay man must build a scrappy new studio. Flirt, film, and manage your way past rivals and wild personalities to turn chaos into your very own gay empire. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻的同性恋者被赶出并进入了他父亲令人发指的成人电影帝国，他必须建立一个斗志旺盛的新工作室。调情、拍摄并管理你的方式超越竞争对手和狂野的人物，将混乱变成你自己的同性恋帝国。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344740/]Steam[/url]]
